backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining Task and AdsMetrics types with CRUD operations for tasks (addTask, editTask, completeTask, addTaskNotes) and ads metrics, storing data in maps with query functions for retrieval by phase, milestone, or all tasks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features: clickable milestone headers for completion toggling, always-visible task notes textarea, task checkbox completion persistence, and progress calculation based on binary completed field.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing a 90-day plan dashboard with 6 phases, 18 milestones, task management, progress tracking, and ADS metrics, starting February 20, 2026, with Spanish UI and phase-based color theming.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for UI components, including six phase-specific colors (phase-1 through phase-6) and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Spanish title 'Dashboard de Plan de 90 Días' and root div mounting the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining root route with Layout wrapper and two child routes: main dashboard at '/' and ADS dashboard at '/ads'.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Application layout component with header showing '90' logo and navigation tabs for Plan de 90 Días and Dashboard ADS, plus footer with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/MilestoneSection: Expandable milestone card with clickable header that toggles completion status of all contained tasks, displaying progress bar, task count, date ranges, and list of TaskCard components when expanded.
Dashboard-wide progress indicator showing completed milestones out of 18 total with percentage and visual progress bar.
Renders a grid of phase buttons showing progress for each of the 6 project phases, with completion badges and progress bars based on milestone completion.
frontend/src/components/ProgressIndicato: Displays a badge indicating task completion status with either a checkmark (completed) or circle (pending) icon.
frontend/src/components/TaskCard.tsx: Displays a task card with checkbox for completion, edit button, due date, day number, and a textarea for internal team notes with auto-save on blur.
frontend/src/components/TaskDialog.tsx: Modal dialog wrapper for creating or editing tasks, containing the TaskForm component.
frontend/src/components/TaskForm.tsx: Form for creating or editing tasks with phase/milestone dropdowns, description input, and due date picker; handles task mutations via useTasks hook.
frontend/src/constants/milestones.ts: Defines the complete 6-phase, 18-milestone flight plan structure with detailed metadata including day ranges, date ranges, titles, and content descriptions for a legal marketing project.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdsMetrics.ts: React Query hook for fetching all ads metrics and adding new ads metrics entries (month, spend, leads, appointments, conversions) via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity state management, and AuthClient configuration for ICP authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useTasks.ts: React hook that provides task management functionality using React Query, including queries for fetching all tasks and mutations for adding, editing, completing tasks, and adding notes.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm earth-toned color palette (avoiding blue/purple) for both light and dark modes, including phase-specific colors and chart colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdsDashboard.tsx: Dashboard page for tracking monthly advertising metrics (spent, leads, appointments, conversions) with a form to add new metrics and a table displaying calculated KPIs like cost per lead and conversion rates.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying a 90-day flight plan with phase navigation, overall progress tracking, milestone sections with tasks, and a dialog for adding new tasks.
frontend/src/utils/adsCalculations.ts: Utility functions for calculating advertising metrics (cost per lead, appointment rate, conversion rate, cost per conversion) and formatting currency and percentage values.
frontend/src/utils/dateUtils.ts: Date utility functions for converting between JavaScript Date and backend Time format (nanoseconds), calculating day numbers within a 90-day period starting from February 20, 2026, and formatting dates in Spanish locale.
frontend/src/utils/progressUtils.ts: Utility functions for calculating progress metrics at milestone, phase, and overall levels by analyzing task completion status across the project structure.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color tokens (using OKLCH color space), container settings, border radius variables, animations, and plugins for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state file defining a 90-day lead generation system dashboard for personal injury law in Utah, structured in 6 phases with 18 milestones. Tracks known issues with checkbox implementation and includes architectural notes about Spanish UI, tech stack (GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, CRM), and target cost per signed client of $500 or less by day 90.
